paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates BLEU scores as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for three candidate-generation settings, shown as three dashed line series with different markers. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from about 1.5 to 13.5, with labeled ticks at 2.5-unit intervals (2.5, 5.0, 7.5, 10.0, 12.5). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, with labeled ticks from 24 up to 31 in steps of 1. The “Inconsistency-CE” series is a blue dashed line with open circle markers, increasing from about 24.1 BLEU at AL ≈ 1.6 to about 30.0 at AL ≈ 11.0, with intermediate points around 26.9 at AL ≈ 3.6, 28.8 at AL ≈ 6.2, and 29.6 at AL ≈ 8.9. The “Consistency-Bi +sampling” series is an orange dashed line with open triangle markers, rising from about 27.8 at AL ≈ 3.4 to about 30.7 at AL ≈ 13.1, passing through approximately 28.9 at AL ≈ 5.0, 29.6 at AL ≈ 7.2, and 30.1 at AL ≈ 10.1. The “Consistency-Bi +beam” series is a green dashed line with open square markers, increasing from about 27.5 at AL ≈ 3.3 to about 31.0 at AL ≈ 12.0, with intermediate values near 28.8 at AL ≈ 4.9, 29.8 at AL ≈ 7.3, and 30.8 at AL ≈ 10.3.
